items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 13 hooks.json files pinned with --no-project (AC-1/2), meta-test + integration test added (AC-3/4), docs updated (AC-5); --python pinning explicitly declined as out of scope.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new system boundary; the change is a flag string in an existing command.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, SQL, HTML, or secrets touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Meta-test asserts command-string outcome; integration test has a positive case and a negative control that proves the pair would have caught the original bug.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB/list endpoints; the fix reduces per-hook work by skipping an unneeded project sync.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New test files follow existing shared/tests/test_hooks_*.py naming/style; all files under 300 LOC.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer identified; the integration test is the round-trip probe (real hooks.json command run through a real subprocess, fixed and unfixed).
